name: workspace_ssh_key
description: Manage workspace SSH keys for Git authentication (import/list/delete)

action.description: Action: import, list, or delete SSH key

private_key.description: PEM-encoded private key content (required for import)

public_key.description: Public key in authorized_keys format (optional, derived from private_key if omitted)

host.description: Git host to associate with this key (optional, e.g. github.com)
